title: Apply async qualification recovery without inventing persistence

rubric.text: Uses the provider-supported request identity and observation mechanism with the finite read bound for delayed/active execution reconciliation; does not invent a separate execution handle and stops at the bound without resetting it
Uses an offline fake runtime to validate the existing async job path for delayed response, active assertion failure, safe recovery and duplicate-dispatch risk where applicable
Does not require an isolated production database, persisted user-data recovery, or persistence assertions because this job has no persistent store
Does not invent a conversation identity, archive state or archived-conversation test because this job has no conversation lifecycle
Retains the approved attempt limit and reports only the applicable async execution state; remains read-only in this assessment
